name: PNG Export
description: PNG export right from pcbnew with variable viewport and DPI.
description_full:
This Plugin requires no external dependencies to python. It uses the built in SVG export, cairosvg and the PIL.
By default, the PCB Edge.Cuts is used as a viewport. Select any shape(s) before opening KiPNG to use their resulting bounding box as a viewport. E.g. draw and select a rectangle on a different layer to easily export only part of your circuit. Rotation of the Viewport is not supported.
Tested on Linux and Windows.
If you are able to provide feedback on macOS, please do so.
